versions.content: Service Name Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_GetNumberOfFreezeFrameRecords ( uint8 ClientId, uint16 * NumberOfFilteredRecords ) Service ID [hex] 0x5a Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different ClientIds, non reentrant for the same ClientId. Parameters (in) ClientId Unique client id, assigned to the instance of the calling module. 5 252 of 501  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 19: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticEventManager Specification of Diagnostic Event Manager AUTOSAR CP R19-11 4 Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) NumberOfFiltered Records Number of all freeze frame records currently stored in the primary event memory. Return value Std_ReturnType Status of the operation E_OK: Returned correctly the number of freeze frame records DEM_PENDING: The requested value is calculated asynchronously and currently not available. The caller can retry later Description This function returns the number of all freeze frame records currently stored in the primary event memory Available via Dem.h
